name: Kitchen and dining
fixed: Ceiling beam where an older wall was removed
Range and chimney hood on side wall
description: Single-story house, kitchen and dining combined. A previous owner removed a wall and left a visible ceiling beam between the dining end and the kitchen. Peninsula island with butcher block top. Black range cooker under a chimney hood. Washing machine sits under the kitchen counter. Black double fridge at right. Long reclaimed table and bench run the length of the room toward a floor-to-ceiling bookcase. Sliders open to the garden at the back. Dark stained wood floor.
